responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the statement-building and function-body API implemented by m2statement.cc. It exposes foreign procedures for function entry/exit, returns, assignments, gotos, labels, call and parameter construction, conditional blocks and jumps, cleanup/try-finally helpers, inline asm, set mutation helpers, and module initialization-function generation.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2statement group: it publishes the statement-building and function-body procedures as FOR "C" imports for Modula-2 code, unlike m2statement.h's C/C++ prototypes and m2statement.cc's implementation.
